annotations.text:
PHOTONIC — your headline, your spiral.

Kept: "Yu, Yao-Hsing 尤耀星" as the headline (78px Space Grotesk, gradient across it), the eyebrow, the lead, the award line, and the phase-portrait spiral — the same damped-spiral maths the site runs today (eigenvalues A±Bi, A=-0.5 B=-1.4, 200 particles, deterministic seed, click to burst, cursor stirs the flow).

Made to match its surroundings: the canvas is transparent, so the violet/cyan field shows through it instead of a black square sitting on top. Trails fade by erasing alpha (destination-out) rather than painting a ground over them, and the strokes composite additively so the spiral adds light to the field. Ramp moved to cyan→blue→violet to read against #08080c.

Before I touch the site: does the light theme survive, or is it dark-only now?
Kept here for reference, not chosen. The light drafting-sheet direction — if you ever want the opposite of Photonic, this is the sketch to come back to.
